name: stark-language
description: Syntax highlighting, snippets, and first-pass standard library completions for Stark.

scripts.check: node --check extension.js && node --check scripts/generate-stdlib-index.js && node --check scripts/check-keyword-coverage.js && node -e "for (const f of ['package.json','language-configuration.json','syntaxes/stark.tmLanguage.json','snippets/stark.json','data/stdlib-symbols.json']) JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(f, 'utf8'))" && node scripts/check-keyword-coverage.js
